descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S24 「用药的 prompt 和防护规则和 p7.2 playground 一致，每处改动都有 Vikram 的批准」 Medication prompts and guard match the p7.2 playground, and every change has Vikram's approval

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T2 Prompt changes are approved by Vikram.（TFA-92597 AC 6）
  • T7 Medication prompts, templates and rules match the p7.2 playground unless Vikram approved a change; prototype vs golden-set disagreements are flagged, not resolved silently; …（TFA-94229 AC 1；TFA-94229 AC 2；TFA-94229 R1；TFA-94229 R2；TFA-94229 R7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given p7.2 playground (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html), TRACKER_GOLDEN_SET.md, EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md, prompts library v1 (medications/events.md, the pre-round parse prompt, the note prompts' medication lines), docs/2026-10-03-vikram-prompt-batch.md

When Diff the medication prompts and guard rules against p7.2; list every wording change since the port with where its approval is recorded; list prototype vs golden-set disagreements; compare S09/S10's property checks with EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md

Then No unapproved wording change; disagreements (e.g. IV drip vs oral pill) flagged, not silently resolved; S09/S10 checks consistent with the framework

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Document review; an unapproved change is a Fail of T2 (TFA-92597 AC 6 is still open per the snapshot) and of T7 (gated)

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。
